facts_raw.Foundshore Verdict: 低优先级 / 仅特定场景
facts_raw.Funding / Support: Possible €100K or €50K investment after program, solely at SWG discretion
facts_raw.Funding Trigger: End-of-program pitch / separate SWG investment decision
facts_raw.Equity / Economic Terms: Program inscription: €1,000+VAT individual / €1,500+VAT team / €500+VAT CTO. If €100K investment accepted, €35K fee obligation; if €50K accepted, €20K fee obligation. Exact equity/conversion terms in investment offer.
facts_raw.Official / Must-Have Requirements: Early founder / team seeking company-building support; paid enrollment.
facts_raw.Strong-to-Have: 全职创始团队；清晰 founder-market fit；可演示产品/MVP；真实用户/客户验证；明确下一阶段里程碑与融资用途。
facts_raw.On-site / Attendance: 未公开明确统一要求；按项目地点 Online 和当期 cohort 安排确认。
facts_raw.Visa / Relocation: 未见公开统一签证支持；若需赴美/赴欧线下参加，必须自行确认合法入境与停留资格。
facts_raw.Application Materials: 通常需团队/公司/产品/市场/traction/融资信息；具体以当期官方申请表为准。
facts_raw.Public Contact Route: 官方申请入口优先；若官网未公开联系人，不建议猜测个人联系方式。
facts_raw.Foundshore Best Fit: B2B / Enterprise SaaS；阶段以 Idea–pre-seed 为主。
facts_raw.Foundshore Not Fit: 已进入成熟增长期、仅寻求销售渠道而非创业加速的公司
facts_raw.Notes: Foundshore: important to flag as paid program with investment only conditional after the program; do not display €100K as guaranteed.
